name: Minha Receita (public CNPJ API)
tier_rationale: Well-known open-source community project (MIT, moved from GitHub to Codeberg) that ingests the Receita Federal CNPJ open-data dump; identifiable maintainer, public documentation and a multi-year public track record (A8 community). 'Tiers: BrasilAPI, Minha Receita, CNPJ.ws and Querido Diario (Open Knowledge Brasil) community.' (P236 cond 1).

reliability.justification: Community relay of the monthly RFB CNPJ dump: values are as good as the snapshot it serves (dump month published at /updated); companies opened after the last dump are missing (P236 cond 6).

cnpj.title: Minha Receita CNPJ lookup /{cnpj} and RFB dump month /updated

terms.quote: Sources at release (class open, legal_dpo): BrasilAPI and Minha Receita (MIT code, RFB open data; one shared parser), publica.cnpj.ws public API (only free source of state IE) and Querido Diario company/partners.

cnpj.notes: Quote: binding council text (P236 cond 1). Research C0510 terms 'MIT (moved from GitHub to Codeberg)' / 'Code MIT; data = RFB open data.' Endpoints https://minhareceita.org/{cnpj} (same schema as BrasilAPI CNPJ v1, one parser; 404 {message} for an unknown or alphanumeric CNPJ, 400 for a wrong check digit) and https://minhareceita.org/updated ({message: 'YYYY-MM'}, the dump month used for freshness ranking and the not-found wording, P236 cond 5-6). BrasilAPI relays this service (identical bodies): both are one ingestion pipeline for the two-upstream not-found rule. No published limit: be gentle (min_interval 1 s, concurrency 1); 8 s per provider in the chain (P236 cond 3); cache 72 h (P236 cond 7). Used by cnpj_lookup.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G10-2 (P236). Single-batch host (owners.json maps minhareceita.org to no provider). ttl 259200 = CNPJ class (P326 cond 7).
